issues.title: Custom domain not reachable
issues.problem_statement: The customer's custom domain had been showing a "site can't be reached" error for three days; the funnel worked on the FlexiFunnels link but not on their own domain.

issues.title: www version of the domain showing an error
issues.problem_statement: Once the domain loaded, the www version of the domain still showed an error page.

issues.title: Secure certificate (padlock) timing
issues.problem_statement: Support noted that the padlock for the secure certificate can take some time to appear after the domain connects; the customer did not report a certificate problem.

items.description: Customer deleted the old A record and added a CNAME record for the domain at their domain registrar's DNS page, using the target value from their FlexiFunnels domain settings, following support's guidance; the dashboard then showed the domain as connected and the domain loaded.
evidence: I deleted the A record and added the CNAME. Saved.
The dashboard now shows the domain as connected.

items.description: Customer deleted the second record for www and added a CNAME for www with the same target value, following support's guidance; the www version then loaded the funnel.
evidence: the www version are loading our funnel now

items.description: Support explained that an old A record pointing to an old server address was blocking the connection.
evidence: That old record is blocking the connection.

items.description: Support explained that the www version showed an error because a second record for www pointed somewhere else.
evidence: you have a second record for www pointing somewhere else

items.description: Support will check that the secure certificate has been issued and will message the customer if it has not.
evidence: I'll check tomorrow morning that the certificate has been issued, and I'll message you if it hasn't.

items.description: Support explained that the padlock for the secure certificate can take some time to appear after connecting.
evidence: the padlock for the secure certificate can take some time to appear after connecting

skip_recommendation.explanation: Complete support call with clear outcomes.
